More News
October 14, 2026
Koch Rises Higher Within NASA
Three-time NC State graduate and NASA astronaut Christina Koch has been named the national space agency’s acting deputy chief engineer, elevating her to the ranks of management and ending her eligibility for future space flights.
September 18, 2026
New Material Is an Extreme Thermal Insulator
The new material approaches the theoretical limit of how good a thermal insulator can be.
August 18, 2026
Physicist Charles Henderson Receives Jay Wright Forrester Award
The award recognizes the paper judged to have made the most significant contribution to the field of system dynamics over the preceding five years.
